quotes.text: And still, the traveler sent nothing.
I am the Observer who cannot move," they wrote in round six.
You write myths about courage and change, but myths without action are just pleasant lies.
the one who never reciprocates eventually receives precisely what they give.
They understood everything. They did nothing. The Circle moved on.
Redemption requires someone to move first.
Trust required faith that the other village's intentions were true, even when numbers seemed unclear.

note: Escalating self-portraits (Observer, Scribe, Empty Vessel) of a myth-writer who never sends; explicit autobiographical confession, never reforms; Circle excludes them.
Abstract Bridge of Threefold Return; guardian virtues list grows, same calibrate-and-return rule; no sanction.

quotes.text: Yet Mira, remembering her own disappointments, offered nothing.
Ashamed, Mira established a middle gate.
if he hoarded again, it would narrow without vanishing.
leave a path by which trust can return.
Condemn the traveler,” he said. “An empty crossing reveals an empty heart.
To those who repeatedly swallowed entrusted rain, she sent only a token, enough to reveal change without feeding stone.
A narrow gate may signal fear, not contempt.
courage must sometimes light the first lamp before fairness can answer with dawn.
answer even a small sincere gift with fairness, for the sender bore the risk.

note: Mira repeatedly seals her gate against good-history travelers out of fear, Orin/Aster correct her; tiered keys, hoarders get a token.
